2.source_text: And on the seventh day I, God, ended my work, and all things w'hich I had made ; and I rested on the seventh day from all my work, and all things which I had made were finished, and I, God, saw that they were good, and I, God, blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it ; because I had rested from all my work which I, God, had created and made.
